766720101.text: Mission accomplished! Heh, looks like a whole new camp.

766720102.text: Yup! Even the fortifications are complete, too. Any attackers, be they monsters or otherwise, will have a hard time overcoming our defenses now.

766720103.text: The lighthouse has half a month's worth of fuel supplies, so even in the event of some massive Wild Hunt assault, we should be able to hold out until reinforcements arrive.

766720105.text: Haha, I just... It always pays to be prepared for the worst, y'know.

766720106.text: Either way, guess you can take a bit of a break now that it's all done.

766720107.text: Right, and that's why I'll be taking a trip home first. I mean, it's been a while since I've seen my old pops.

766720108.text: Home? Ohhh, yeah. Paimon's gotten so used to seeing you here, she almost forgot you're actually from Piramida.

766720109.text: Why don't you come along? If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to host you at our place.

766720110.text: We've set up a food truck here as per Paimon's suggestion, but cooking at home is more convenient all the same.

766720111.text: Ooh, so you'll be cooking? Well, you're in luck — 'cause Paimon never says no to a tasty meal!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to Illuga's home in Piramida

766720202.text: Lakkaberry Krumkakes, Smoked Fish Steak, Berries and Fried Meat, and Nightwatch Soup... There's so much here — almost too much, even for Paimon!

766720203.text: Hmm... I made this according to the amount we'd usually cook for our troops at dinner. So yeah... it might be a bit much for three.

766720204.text: No worries, though, just take your time. I'll need to go see my old pops in a bit, so feel free to stay until evening.

766720208.text: Well, I did cook for everyone a lot before taking up my current post. It's just that I haven't had the time recently.

766720209.text: The people of Piramida come from every corner of the world, so there's a wide variety of palates to cater for. In other words, it pays to dabble.

766720210.text: But since I'm not yet familiar with your preferences, I just made a bit of everything. If there's anything here you particularly like, don't hesitate to say so.

766720207.text: Well of course, hehe, that goes without saying! Can't just let a good friend's efforts go to waste! Still, Paimon didn't expect you'd be such a good cook either, Illuga.

766729901.text: You jump aboard the Moonwagon, and before long, you've reached Piramida...
